scenario.irule:
when HTTP_REQUEST {
  log local0. "action=[BOTDEFENSE::action] anomalies=[BOTDEFENSE::bot_anomalies] categories=[BOTDEFENSE::bot_categories]"
  log local0. "bot=[BOTDEFENSE::bot_name] sig=[BOTDEFENSE::bot_signature] sigcat=[BOTDEFENSE::bot_signature_category]"
  log local0. "captcha=[BOTDEFENSE::captcha_status] age=[BOTDEFENSE::captcha_age] cookie=[BOTDEFENSE::cookie_status] cage=[BOTDEFENSE::cookie_age]"
  log local0. "class=[BOTDEFENSE::client_class] type=[BOTDEFENSE::client_type] device=[BOTDEFENSE::device_id] intent=[BOTDEFENSE::intent]"
  log local0. "micro=[BOTDEFENSE::micro_service name]/[BOTDEFENSE::micro_service type] previous=[BOTDEFENSE::previous_action]/[BOTDEFENSE::previous_request_age]/[BOTDEFENSE::previous_support_id]"
  log local0. "reason=[BOTDEFENSE::reason] support=[BOTDEFENSE::support_id] possible=[BOTDEFENSE::cs_possible] allowed=[BOTDEFENSE::cs_allowed] attr=[BOTDEFENSE::cs_attribute device_id]"
  set override [BOTDEFENSE::action block]
  BOTDEFENSE::cs_allowed false
  BOTDEFENSE::cs_attribute device_id false
  BOTDEFENSE::disable
  BOTDEFENSE::enable
  log local0. "override=$override action=[BOTDEFENSE::action] allowed=[BOTDEFENSE::cs_allowed] attr=[BOTDEFENSE::cs_attribute device_id]"
}
when BOTDEFENSE_REQUEST { log local0. botdefense-request }
when BOTDEFENSE_ACTION { log local0. botdefense-action }
